name: TextVQA
intro: TextVQA 是要求模型读取图像中文字并回答问题的视觉问答 benchmark，常出现在多模态模型报告中。
org: UNC Chapel Hill, Georgia Tech, Facebook AI Research
build_method: Open Images筛选, 众包问题与10答案标注, honeypot质检
build_method_en: Open Images filtering, crowdsourced questions and ten answers, honeypot quality control
intro_en: TextVQA is a visual question-answering benchmark requiring models to read text in images and answer questions, frequently appearing in multimodal model reports.
scale_en: 28,408 images, 45,336 questions, and ten answers per question

drawio_review_note: Aligned with TextVQA paper, Sections 3-4; official TextVQA project page. TextVQA starts from Open Images, applies automatic OCR and a human text-presence screen, and retains 28,408 images. Crowd workers write one or two questions that require reading scene text; a second question must differ and have a different answer. Ten independent answers are collected per question. Majority quality flags and honeypot questions remove invalid work. The 45,336 questions are split without image overlap into 34,602 train, 5,000 validation, and 5,734 test questions. Evaluation combines the image, question, and OCR tokens and reports the standard VQA soft accuracy against the ten human answers.
